new_value: Implemented SLICE 5 (control/terminal + integration seam): new module schc_session_control.{c,h} composing slices 1-4. (a) Control authorization: every control path revalidates the slice-3 gate (authenticated + current generation); no API accepts a caller-supplied generation token. (b) ACK-REQ/C=0-ACK ambiguity classified from the AUTHENTICATED SENDER ROLE (same Rule ID both legs; data sender->ACK_REQ, receiver->ACK, mismatched rule/role->INVALID) BEFORE any decoder or state mutation. (c) 4-ACK-then-abort: receiver counts ACK responses per session; the 5th otherwise-valid All-1/ACK-REQ -> Receiver-Abort + terminal hold-down (tombstone + floor recorded, session retired). (d) Tombstone hold-down: within 60s a strictly-newer counter replays the SAME terminal response idempotently without starting a session and advances the tombstone high-water; the floor tracks the generation-scoped high-water (monotonic raise) so after hold-down the floor persists as the durable admission floor gating the next session's opener. (e) Link/L2 seam: read-only metadata (session_active/high_water/ack_count/floor) + single-object install/revoke pass-throughs; revoke frees session records and atomically retires trust record + tables. (f) Atomicity: open checks gate/admission/both allocations before any write; stale/out-of-space counters mutate nothing; the ONLY failure with a control response is authenticated allocation exhaustion (one Receiver-Abort, no eviction, per spec). 7 unit tests green (classification, authorization gating, open admission, 4-ACK-then-abort+holddown replay, floor persistence after expiry, atomic errors, revoke retirement), ASan+UBSan -Werror -Wconversion, cppcheck clean; sibling suites still green (11/11, 14/14, 6/6, 11/11). REVIEW: delegated kimi-k3 timed out twice without verdict; implementer self-review (correctness) found+fixed one real defect (floor did not track the hold-down high-water advance) before commit. Unblocks l1qw.3.7.3.
